prompt: Why should the crew keep the torn strip?
promptZh: 清潔班為什麼要留著破掉的橡膠條？

options.text: The lead will compare its length with replacements.
options.zh: 領班要拿它和新的橡膠條比對長度。
options.whyZh: 留著舊橡膠條是為了新貨送到後能比對長度。

options.text: The dry head needs part of it to work.
options.zh: 乾式吸頭需要用到它的一部分。
options.whyZh: 乾式吸頭是分開的，目前就能用，不需要破掉的橡膠條。

options.text: It will be used to mark the west lift.
options.zh: 要拿它在西側電梯做記號。
options.whyZh: 橡膠條要掛在物料間，不是拿去電梯旁做記號。

options.text: The delivery driver will take it away.
options.whyZh: 領班要在新貨送到時拿它比對，沒有請司機帶走。

explanationZh: 留著舊橡膠條是為了新貨送到後能比對長度。
evidence: I need to match its length against the new ones when the delivery comes.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: I need to match its length against the new ones when the delivery comes.

vocabulary.note: match 在此指核對尺寸是否相同
when 子句用現在式表示未來時間
